section_summary.extract_value: This Introduction reviews the development of the Body Appreciation Scale and its 10-item revision (BAS-2), summarizes prior cross-cultural validations, and motivates validating the BAS-2 in Denmark, Portugal, and Sweden. The present study (singular) aims to examine the BAS-2 factor structure, measurement invariance across sex and country, and convergent validity (including correlations with self-esteem, well-being, intuitive eating, and BMI) among adolescent and young adult males and females in these three countries.
section_summary.evidence_source: Key sentences: 'The present study aimed to validate the BAS-2 among adolescents and young adults from three different countries: Denmark, Portugal, and Sweden.' and 'Second, the measurement invariance of the BAS-2 across sex and country was assessed.' and 'Third, we examined the convergent validity ... by examining their correlations with self-esteem, psychological well-being, intuitive eating, and BMI in both sexes.'
